mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders ( order_at, app_at, total_price, user_id, store_id ) VALUES ( NOW(), NULL, 0, NULL, #{storeId} );
mapper.select:
SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, od.order_detail_id AS orderDetailId, od.order_status AS orderStatus
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_at AS orderAt, s.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, MIN(i.ingredient_name) AS firstIngredientName, COUNT(DISTINCT od.ingredient_id) AS ingredientCount, o.total_price AS totalPrice, MAX(od.store_at) AS storeAt,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '대기' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '승인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '거절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '부분' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '승인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN '승인' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '거절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN '거절' ELSE '부분' END AS orderStatus
FROM orders o JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id
s.user_id = #{userId}
AND ( s.store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{storeName}, '%') OR CAST(o.order_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderId}, '%') )
AND s.store_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{storeName}, '%')
AND CAST(o.order_id AS CHAR) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{orderId}, '%')
AND o.order_at >= #{startDate} AND o.order_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_id, s.store_name, o.total_price
HAVING 1 = 1
AND orderStatus = #{orderStatus}
AND MAX(od.store_at) >= #{startDate} AND MAX(od.store_at) < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY o.order_at DESC

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_at AS orderAt, s.store_name AS storeName,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '대기'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '승인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '거절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '부분'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '승인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN '승인'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '거절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN '거절'
ELSE '부분' END AS orderStatus,
o.app_at AS appAt, MAX(od.store_at) AS storeAt, o.total_price AS totalPrice, u.user_name AS userName
FROM orders o
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId} AND s.user_id = #{userId}
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, s.store_name, o.app_at, o.total_price, u.user_name

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_at AS orderAt,
MIN(i.ingredient_name) AS ingredientName, COUNT(DISTINCT od.ingredient_id) AS ingredientCount,
o.total_price AS totalPrice,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '대기'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '승인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '거절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '부분'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '승인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN '승인'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '거절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN '거절'
ELSE '부분' END AS orderStatus,
MAX(od.store_at) AS storeAt
FROM orders o
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id
JOIN stores s ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE s.user_id = #{userId}
AND o.order_at >= #{startDate} AND o.order_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM order_details od2 WHERE od2.order_id = o.order_id AND od2.store_at >= #{startDate} AND od2.store_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) )
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, o.total_price
ORDER BY CASE WHEN MAX(od.store_at) IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, MAX(od.store_at) DESC, o.order_at DESC, o.order_id DESC
ORDER BY o.order_at DESC, o.order_id DESC

SELECT o.order_id AS orderId, o.order_at AS orderAt, o.total_price AS totalPrice,
CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '대기'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '승인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '거절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '부분'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '승인' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN '승인'
WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN od.order_status = '거절' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN '거절'
ELSE '부분' END AS orderStatus,
MAX(od.app_at) AS appAt, MAX(od.store_at) AS storeAt
FROM orders o
JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id
WHERE o.store_id = #{storeId}
GROUP BY o.order_id, o.order_at, o.total_price
ORDER BY o.order_id DESC
